_comment: Single source of truth for everything LANGUAGE-SPECIFIC in preprocess_ipa_childes_split.py.
Adding / switching a language is a DATA change here, not a code change in the script.
Top-level keys:
'default_language' : language key used when --language is not passed on the CLI.
'languages'        : map of <language-key> -> profile. The key is what you pass to
--language (e.g. 'de', 'en-us'); it does NOT have to equal the
espeak voice, that is the 'voice' field below.
Per-language profile fields:
'voice'              : espeak-ng voice code (e.g. 'de', 'en-us') used both as the
phonemizer voice and as the key for per-voice atom lookup on
rows whose CSV lang column matches it.
'number_locale'      : which number->words rule set text_normalize.py applies when
--normalize-numbers is on ('de' or 'en'). Digits are dropped by
the digit-free grapheme vocab, so they must be spelled out.
'multi_char_phonemes': whitelist of MULTI-codepoint espeak-ng IPA atoms that the
longest-match tokenizer must keep whole (diphthongs, affricates,
...). These are derived from real espeak-ng output for the voice.
Long vowels (eː, uː, ...), nasalization, syllabicity etc. are NOT
listed here: they are 'base char + combining mark' and handled
generically by is_attaching() for every language.
'self_check'         : word -> [raw espeak-ng IPA, expected token list]. Pinned against
real espeak-ng output; run_self_check() fails loudly on any
regression (in the code OR in this file) that stops merging
diphthongs/affricates/length-marks into single atomic tokens.
'phoneme_inventory'  : AUTHORITATIVE set of single-codepoint base phones the language may
emit (stress ˈˌ / length ː / combining marks stripped before the
check). Together with multi_char_phonemes it is the metadata the
vocab is validated against: preprocess builds the phoneme vocab from
observed tokens but FAILS LOUDLY (build_voice_phone_sets +
atoms_are_in_language + the final vocab assertion) if any token's
base is not declared here. Rows espeak phonemizes with a language
switch ((en)…) or '?' are dropped and reported, never voc-added.
Empty list = no phoneme validation (backward compatible).
'grapheme_inventory' : AUTHORITATIVE set of grapheme characters text_graphemes may contain.
The grapheme vocab is asserted to be a subset of this; anything else
(mojibake/CJK/symbols) is a data/config bug surfaced at generation,
not silently voc-added. MUST stay consistent with the data-cleaning
char_policy in prepare/config/<lang>/general_base_resources.json.
Empty = no grapheme validation (backward compatible).
German atoms/self_check/inventory derived from real `espeak-ng` voice 'de' over 20k clean
German words: aɪ (mein), aʊ (Haus), ɔø (heute) diphthongs; pf/ts/tʃ/dʒ affricates (ɔø not
ɔʏ is what espeak-ng 'de' emits). phoneme_inventory is the 41 base phones espeak-ng 'de'
actually produces; w/θ/ð/ɹ/ɒ/ʌ/nasal ɑ̃… are ENGLISH/FRENCH and intentionally absent so
language-switch contamination fails the check instead of leaking into the vocab.
